verdict.rationale: Render is a cloud application platform, so edge compute is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows no capability for running code on a global edge network near end users. The only related item is a global CDN that caches static assets, which is an adjacent feature rather than edge code execution, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run my code on a global edge network close to end users
